tool.title: Does every node have an IRI, a .jsonld, a page and a row?
tool.description: For each node a declared directory holds, per layer × folder × kind: whether it has an IRI in its layer's export (extensionless), its JSON-LD at `<iri>.jsonld` (and `.json` where its source is JSON), a view page at `<locale>/<harness>/<vis>/<instance>/<id>/`, and a row on its folder page that links to it; plus the folder page's dead links and raw-repository links, and whether a viewer is declared. Folder pages are read with their data files, so rows drawn by JavaScript count. Writes `node-view-coverage/v1`, one file per layer, under `test/results/node-views/`.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: `--site <dir>`: a built site (`_site`, or a preview's `branches/<slug>/`). With `--site-url`, the URL that directory is served at.

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: `--base <url>`: a live site to probe instead of a directory. Optional; one of `site` or `base` is needed, or pages, rows and links are unknown.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: `--check` (`node-views:judge`): write nothing and judge. Exit 0 when no finding is new, 1 when one is new against the baseline, 2 when the run could not ask (JUDGEMENT_EXIT).

inputs.name: against
inputs.description: `--against <ref>`: the `qa-reports` entry to judge against (`main`, `main/<sha>`, `pr/<n>/<sha>`). Absent, the working copy; a missing baseline is UNKNOWN and not gated.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: `<layer qa home>/node-views/<layer>.node-views.qa.json` (`node-view-coverage/v1`), and a Markdown summary table on stdout. Always exit 0: reports, never gates. Published to `qa-reports` by `qa:publish`, and read by each layer's QA page.

selection.when: After a site build, before the review of a preview: to see which nodes of which folders have no IRI, no .jsonld, no page or no row, and which folder links are dead or point at the raw repository.
selection.limits: It needs a built site or a live base; without one, pages, rows and links are unknown, never 0. Rows drawn in the browser are read from the folder's data files (`assets/<vis>/*.json`, inline JSON), not by running the page, so a row built from another source is not seen. The census per kind is a declared file rule (`CENSUS_RULES`) or the layer's export, recorded on each row. Counts past `--probe-limit` are unknown.
selection.cost: Building each layer's export in memory (minutes over a whole composition), then one request per node page and IRI: thousands against a live base.

$comment.comment: `network` is false for `--site` and true for `--base` (and for `--site --network`, which fetches off-site IRIs). Declared false because the default input is a built directory.
`kg-viewer` states the rule this measures: every asset has its own IRI, its JSON-LD and a page, and the asset and its rendering are two resources.
